# NEXAI

> NEXAI builds intelligent AI employees — voice agents, chatbots, an online booking calendar, a CRM, custom apps and automations that save time, cut costs and grow revenue. An AI agency based in Frankenhardt, working across Germany. The website is available in German (default) and English.

## Products
- [Voice Agent](https://nex-a-i.com/en/produkte/voice-agent): A phone assistant that answers around the clock, advises and books appointments.
- [Chat Agent](https://nex-a-i.com/en/produkte/chat-agent): A chatbot for your website that advises, recommends and answers instantly.
- [NexAI Calendar](https://nex-a-i.com/en/produkte/nexai-kalender): An online booking calendar where customers book themselves and get confirmations and reminders by email or SMS.
- [NexAI CRM](https://nex-a-i.com/en/produkte/nexai-crm): A customer system where calls, enquiries, appointments and tasks come together automatically, on servers in Germany.
- [Automation](https://nex-a-i.com/en/produkte/automatisierung): Takes over repetitive tasks and connects your programs with each other.
- [NexAI App](https://nex-a-i.com/en/produkte/nexai-app): Your own installable app for customers or staff, in your brand, no app store needed.

## Main pages
- [Services](https://nex-a-i.com/en/services): Digital employees for every department — what NEXAI builds.
- [Products](https://nex-a-i.com/en/produkte): All ready-made AI products at a glance.
- [Pricing](https://nex-a-i.com/en/pricing): Packages and pricing.
- [About](https://nex-a-i.com/en/about): About NEXAI.
- [Sales partners](https://nex-a-i.com/en/vertriebspartner): Become a self-employed setter or closer (m/f/d), commission-based, remote across DACH.
- [Closer job](https://nex-a-i.com/en/vertriebspartner/closer-job): Remote closer role for AI employees, appointments from the setter pool, commission only.
- [Setter job](https://nex-a-i.com/en/vertriebspartner/setter-job): Remote setter role, verified company contacts, appointments for closers, commission only.
- [Commercial agents](https://nex-a-i.com/en/vertriebspartner/handelsvertreter): Commercial agency (§ 84 HGB) for AI employees with recurring commission.
- [Contact](https://nex-a-i.com/en/contact): Get in touch or book a call.
